title: Figure 54: acoustic pressure magnitude vs radial distance, 10,000 Hz in water
description: ANSYS 12.1 line graph of steady-state magnitude of pressure (Pa) versus radial distance (m) for 10,000 Hz with 25 elements per wavelength in water. Smooth 1/r decay for the uniformly radiating sphere EPW=25, closing the BAASS 1-10 kHz underwater acoustic frequency comparison.
